text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The spring G1 races for the senior year are just around the corner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then, one evening…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hmm, so what should I be going after…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: What do I wanna do? What kind of person do I want to be?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: There's gotta be something else I want… but I can't figure it out. Why is that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I was just figuring out my goals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: For this year, or rather, this year and beyond—what I'm running for.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I thought I should finally figure out an answer to that. I do have an idea of what direction I want to go in, at least.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I wanna use my shredded physique to become the kind of racer who can surpass McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Which is good and all, and I should be working solely toward that…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She still has a frown on her face. It seems like there's more on her mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Well! I guess that should be enough, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: If I work hard and beat McQueen, then I should be pumped in body and mind! So I guess that's what I'll do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: …You think I'm foolin'?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: How… How'd you know that? Geez…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She looks at me like I just rubbed salt onto a wound. Maybe there's something Mejiro Ryan longs for even more, deep inside herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I ask her why she's always admired McQueen so much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You know… It's McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: She's always beautiful… No matter the time or place, she's so elegant and dignified…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Her presence alone can change the whole mood of a place, make it into an entirely different world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: And… she's always surrounded by people who love her—even outside the family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: And I… I…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I wanted to be like her… I wanted to be a star!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh!
choice_data_list: Looks like you found your answer.
Looks like you found your answer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Me, a star? Like Oguri and McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: There's no way… Not me! I could never be!
choice_data_list: But that's what you want to become, right?
But that's what you want to become, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah… I really do. I want to be like them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It's frustrating and embarrassing to admit it, but I do… I wanna be a racing star.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But… I have no idea of how I can do it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After spilling her guts, Ryan calms down a little. We continue our conversation as we walk.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: What do you think "star quality" is exactly?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen has her elegance, Oguri's races are always full of excitement…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It's not just their looks, and it's not just their speed either. What is it, exactly?
choice_data_list: I don't really know to tell the truth.
I don't really know to tell the truth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Aw man, really? I thought you might have some idea.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But… maybe that's just the way it is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: We all have that certain something that just can't be gained by working hard.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I might be asking for too much… but it's good to finally know what I really want.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She gives me a sad smile, her fragile heart now burdened with a difficult question.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I know that I can be childish to an almost pathetic degree, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I need your help, so keep stickin' with me, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's her senior year now. Although she's grown more competitive, Ryan is still a child at heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The cruel spring season waits for no one, however. She has no choice but to embrace that fragility and keep running.
